EC1: OAT required for reasons [NOT] not related to AF (i.e., prosthetic valve [OR], PV stenosis [OR], previous pulmonary embolism [OR], presence of spontaneous echo contrast [SEC] at standard echo performed at 3-months follow-up).
EC2: Any cardiac surgery [OR] within the past 60 days (2 months) or valvular cardiac surgical procedure at any time (i.e., ventriculotomy [OR], atriotomy [OR], and valve [OR] repair [OR] or replacement and presence of a prosthetic valve)
EC3: Previous myocardial infarction [OR] (MI) or a percutaneous coronary intervention PCI within the past 3 months
EC4: Awaiting cardiac transplantation [OR] or other cardiac surgery within the next 365 days (12 months)
EC6: Significant pulmonary disease, (e.g., restrictive pulmonary disease [OR], constrictive or COPD) or any other disease or malfunction of the lungs or respiratory system that produces chronic symptoms
EC7: Significant medical problem that in the opinion of the investigator would preclude enrollment in this study
EC8: Women who are pregnant (as evidenced by pregnancy test if pre-menopausal)
EC9: Acute illness or active systemic infection [OR] or sepsis
EC11: Contraindication [AND] to anticoagulation (i.e., heparin [OR], warfarin or another commercially available anticoagulation medication)
EC12: History of blood clotting [OR] or bleeding abnormalities
EC13: Life expectancy less than 360 days (12 months)
EC14: Uncontrolled Heart Failure [OR] or NYHA Class III [OR] or IV heart failure
EC15: Enrollment in a clinical study evaluating another device or drug, within the past 6 months
EC16: Unable or unwilling to comply with protocol requirements
